verdict.rationale: kitty documents a dedicated Terminal graphics protocol that lets client programs render arbitrary raster graphics in the terminal, and ships the icat kitten for displaying images inline. A hands-on community user calls icat a must-have, which corroborates real use. Missing for 10: the evidence pack has no in-depth excerpts covering the protocol's richer features (animation, placement, transmission modes), and there is no independent corroboration of the protocol beyond icat use.
